questions.question: How would you translate a business requirement such as 'improve visibility into payment exceptions' into technical specifications for developers, including data fields, business rules, integrations, error handling, and testable acceptance criteria?

Describe how you would turn a request from a healthcare operations manager to reduce claim-processing rework into a set of validated business requirements, including stakeholders, assumptions, acceptance criteria, and open questions.

You are supporting two urgent production issues, a requirements workshop, and a scheduled reporting deliverable, all due this week. How would you assess urgency, communicate trade-offs, and reprioritize the team's work?

Describe any Agile environment you have worked in. If your prior work was not formally Agile, explain how you would participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.

How would you create a current-state and future-state process flow for a patient-facing workflow that currently has duplicate data entry across two systems? Explain the notation, decision points, exceptions, owners, and validation steps you would include.

In your fraud coordinator role, when you created rules to prevent chargeback, refund, or promotion-scheme losses, how did you establish the business problem, decide what data was needed, and document the resulting rule requirements?

This role requires at least five years of related experience. Walk us through which parts of your Data Analyst and Fraud Coordinator, team-lead, and other roles you consider directly relevant to IT system business analysis, and where you would need support initially.
Walk us through the end-to-end business analysis lifecycle you would use from an initial business request through requirements approval, solution delivery, testing, and post-implementation review.
Give an example of a period when you had several competing reports, analyses, or team responsibilities. What system did you use to track work, protect deadlines, and escalate capacity constraints?

How would you build a feasibility report for automating a manual healthcare operations process? Cover problem definition, options, cost and benefit assumptions, technical and operational risks, dependencies, and recommendation.
